visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a hand gripping a DJI action camera with a purple screw, held above a woven basket. Inside the basket, a green cloth base supports a pinecone-shaped chocolate cake and a coffee cup with a black lid. White napkins are tucked into the side. The background is a dry, brown forest floor with scattered leaves. (2) A woman with long, vibrant purple hair walks along a dirt path in a dense forest. She wears a white long-sleeved shirt, a fuzzy tan vest, and dark leopard-print trousers. She carries two large folding wooden chairs under her arms. Tall coniferous trees line the path, and a wooden railing is visible on the right. (3) The woman continues climbing steep dirt stairs reinforced with wooden planks. The camera follows her from behind, capturing the effort as she ascends into a misty forest environment. The lighting is soft and natural, filtering through the high canopy. Various small green plants grow along the edges of the steps. (4) The scene transitions to a high wooden deck in the woods. The woman walks across the planks with her chairs. A man in a grey knitted beanie and a beige jacket appears. They sit on folding chairs at a wooden table. The woman uses a skewer to feed the man, who makes exaggerated, comical faces of distress and irritation. (5) In an indoor Japanese-style restaurant with warm wooden interiors and large windows, the man and woman are now wearing matching red athletic jackets. The woman uses tongs to grill large shellfish and shrimp over a charcoal fire on the table. The man leans in close to the camera, talking and gesturing toward the food. (6) In a modern, well-lit hotel room, the woman sits on a light-colored sofa in the background, focused on her smartphone. The man enters the foreground wearing a yellow shirt, holding a clear plastic container of fresh red strawberries. He smiles and speaks directly to the camera, looking apologetic and cheerful. (7) The final shot is an extreme close-up of the man's face. He looks directly into the lens with an expression of intense fear and sorrow, blinking rapidly. His eyes are wide, and he appears to be whimpering. The background shows the hotel room's television and the woman still sitting on the sofa.
